sources.title: liodon-ai (Liodon AI) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Liodon AI We are an independent U.S.-based research-driven open-source entity dedicated to advancing the frontier of Small Language Models (SLMs) and high-efficiency deep learning infrastructure. Our goal is to democratize highly capable, compact intelligence that can run seamlessly on low-resource settings without sacrificing reasoning ability.

sources.title: ONNX Model Zoo
sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models. Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers.
